rule: an arm beats its reference in a group only if every lead cell meets all three: (1) the 95 % interval of the median d lies wholly below 0; (2) the upper bound of the 95 % interval of ln(p95_arm / p95_ref) is below ln 1.10; (3) the arm fails on at most 1 % of the pairs
reading: K2 against K1, per lead: the 95 % interval of the median d wholly below 0 is a gain at that lead, wholly above 0 is harm, holding 0 is no detectable effect
